name: Kanban for WooCommerce
author: Nitin Prakash

sections.description:
Kanban for WooCommerce transforms your WooCommerce order management by providing a clear, visual overview of your order workflow. Organize your orders into Kanban boards based on their statuses, making it easy to track progress, identify bottlenecks, and streamline your fulfillment process.
Manage WooCommerce orders like tasks on a visual drag-and-drop Kanban board.
Move orders across statuses instantly, filter by customers or products, and stay in full control of your store workflow — all from one screen.

✅ Stop refreshing WooCommerce Orders. Start managing visually.

🚀 FEATURES (Free Version)

📦 Visual Order Management

  • View all your WooCommerce orders as cards on an interactive Kanban board.
  • Instantly drag & drop orders between Pending, Processing, Completed, etc.
  • Color-coded columns make it easy to track each stage of your fulfillment flow.

🔍 Smart Order Search

  • Search live by order number, customer name, product name, or payment method.
  • Filter results instantly without leaving the board.

⚙️ Real-Time Order Updates

  • Moving a card automatically updates the WooCommerce order status — no reload needed.
  • Built-in AJAX ensures your changes are saved safely and instantly.

🧾 Order Details Popup

  • Click any order card to open a detailed modal view with full order info.
  • Check payment, shipping, and product details without leaving the page.

💡 Responsive Design

  • Works beautifully on desktop, tablet, or large admin dashboards.
  • Minimal UI built with Bootstrap 5 for speed and clarity.

✨ Focus Mode

Go distraction-free with one click.
Toggle Focus Mode to hide the WordPress admin sidebar and top bar — giving you a clean, full-width workspace for maximum productivity.
Perfect for large monitors or daily operations.

Focus Mode gives you a clean, distraction-free workspace by hiding WordPress admin UI elements.
Perfect for fulfillment teams or store managers who spend hours inside WooCommerce.

Features:
– Full-width layout (no sidebar)
– Smooth enter/exit animation
– Sticky toolbar with search + filters
– One-click toggle using the focus icon

Once you try Focus Mode, you’ll never go back to the default WordPress view.

💡 Designed for teams that want efficiency and clarity.

🧠 Smart Analytics & Metrics

  • Real-time order count badges for every list (e.g., “Processing 5/32”).
  • Track your workload at a glance.

🔄 Enhanced Drag & Drop

  • Trello-style animations with smooth transitions.
  • Visual feedback and toast confirmations for every move.

🧱 Team-Ready Performance

  • Optimized for hundreds of orders per screen.
  • Lightweight scripts (no external dependencies).
  • Built using WordPress standards and REST API.

Ideal for:

  • WooCommerce store owners looking for a visual order management system.
  • E-commerce businesses wanting to improve order fulfillment efficiency.
  • Teams needing a collaborative way to manage WooCommerce orders.

🌟 PRO-ONLY FEATURES:

sections.installation:
1. Upload the kanban-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the “Kanban for WooCommerce” plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. “Navigate to WooCommerce -> Kanban for Woo”.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support custom order statuses?

Yes, Kanban for WooCommerce automatically detects your standard and custom WooCommerce order statuses and creates columns for them on your board.

Will this plugin slow down my store?

Absolutely not. It is built for performance. We use AJAX to ensure your dashboard stays lightweight, and it only loads on the specific Kanban board screen.

Can I use this on multiple sites?

Yes, it works great on single-site WooCommerce stores. Multisite support is available in our Pro version.

How do I move orders between statuses?

It’s simple: just drag a card from one column and drop it into another. The order status in WooCommerce will update instantly via AJAX—no page reload required!
